node.title: KoalaBear fixed-literal full-J logarithmic router replay
node.closure: literal source and logarithmic factorization for F05, F06, and F07
node.statement: For each literal assignment F05, F06, and F07, exact source reconstruction gives the full-J constant-coefficient factor pattern w^4 times two degree-8 squares times one degree-11 and one degree-12 factor. On the degree-11 route, equality of the full-J products and nonvanishing of their constant factors gives the logarithmic derivative condition. Its numerator has one irreducible degree-67 factor of w-degree 15, while the only nonnamed denominator factors are two degree-7 and two degree-11 factors, all squared. This gives an exhaustive two-union denominator versus guarded-numerator router separately for each literal assignment. No routed branch is declared empty here.
